scope.summary: Implement the interactive simulation session (CG-14, MD interactive editing + Quick/Advanced Pinching + Preserve-3D-on-2D-scale): a long-running cancellable sim job that continuously steps while accepting in-loop CRDT panel edits (warm-restart preserving drape), plus pinch drag manipulation with soft-selection falloff (shape, distance, power, surface-vs-straight distance, limit-to-pattern) as transient external forces, per Section 13.3 loop + 13.11 jobs + 13.13 leases.
acceptance_criteria: InteractiveSimSession job: runs continuous substeps at interactive budget (Normal preset), streams frames to the viewport (MT-238 path), honors scheduler leases/cancellation, and applies queued garment edits between substeps via incremental constraint rebuild for the touched panels only (no full reload).
2D panel edits during the session preserve the current drape: rest-state changes re-bind while world positions persist (covers MD 'Preserve 3D Garment Shape on 2D Scaling').

Pinch tool: grab particle set with soft-selection falloff and drag as a transient force/constraint; released cloth relaxes; falloff params typed and steerable via MCP (steer_simulation tool addition registered per 13.13 extension discipline).
Session state (running/paused, edit queue depth) exposed in RUNTIME status + TraceProjection; Argus can observe viewport updates headlessly; session end emits a standard SimulationReceipt.

Determinism note recorded: interactive sessions are exploratory (not promotion evidence); promotion still requires a clean deterministic run (13.15) — enforced by receipt flag interactive=true rejected by PromotionGate.
scope.risk_if_missed: Interactive drape-and-tweak is THE core MD working loop; without it every adjustment is a batch job round-trip and both operators and models lose the tighten-loop-fix workflow (also blocks the pinch-based styling models need for micro-adjustments).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Solver/backend/schema producer only. It exposes typed state, diagnostics, receipts, and TraceProjection; the named native workspace owner consumes it without widening this MT's allowed paths.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Cloth simulation and physics

This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

Bind this scope to the native 2D Pattern pane, shared selection/property/history, and queued topology transaction contracts.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
